data.title: Arknights: Endfield × M.RAGE Apparel Collaboration Debuts at LVL UP EXPO 2026
data.brief: Arknights: Endfield is teaming up with M.RAGE on a special apparel collaboration, debuting at LVL
data.data:
Arknights: Endfield is teaming up with M.RAGE on a special apparel collaboration, debuting at LVL UP EXPO 2026 in Las Vegas.

Blending Endfield’s world and characters with M.RAGE’s streetwear approach, the collection features designs inspired by Perlica, Laevatain and Yvonne, bringing key visual elements from the game into a wearable, everyday format.

Fans attending LVL UP EXPO (April 24–26) will be able to explore the collection in person at the M.RAGE booth (Booth #321). The booth will also feature on-site activities, including the opportunity to experience Arknights: Endfield firsthand and take part in event-exclusive moments throughout the show.

The collection will be available across North America starting April 24, 2026, with ongoing availability through March 31, 2028.
